## Candidate generation — `candidates.method`

Candidate recall at an equal pair budget: every method's proposals are ranked by the same IDF gram cosine and cut to the budget below; recall = true pairs of VALID left records that survive. `union` = gram_topk + field_blocks. Budget: FEBRL4 5 pairs per left record; BPID 5 pairs per left record; Abt-Buy 5 pairs per left record; Leipzig 10 pairs per left record; Synthetic 10^6 5 pairs per left record.

Winner: **levenshtein**.

> The highest mean is `jaro_winkler`, but only `levenshtein` may be a default on Spark 4.1.3: D07 forbids a default path that depends on Jaro-Winkler, a UDF before Spark 4.3. It stays available behind `features.udf_features`; the Spark 4.3 watcher triggers the re-decision once it is a built-in.
